messages:
Nina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: why customers pick us or not. Can leadership clarify which signals we should push into the CRM and which require immediate product fixes?

VP_ops: Short answers: push these signals to CRM: procurement friction, required infra (HSM/on-prem), and pricing pushback on embeddings. Immediate product fixes: streamlined Dedicated onboarding and a minimal private deploy installer.

Sam_engineering: To be concrete on the installer ask: engineering needs 2 acceptance criteria for P0: 1) one-command installer that sets up control plane + runtime, 2) automated healthcheck reporting to customer SRE. Anything else?

Elena_sales: From field: wins = low-latency guarantees + transparent cost breakdown. Losses = long procurement cycles (esp. in healthcare), missing KMS/HSM support, and lack of volume discounts for embeddings. Also a few customers wanted a vendor-managed private instance (we currently only offer customer-managed).

Kai_product: Thanks. Product ask: evaluate a phased private offering: Phase A = vendor-managed private (single-tenant) with strict network controls; Phase B = customer-managed installer. Which is higher priority?

VP_ops: Phase A is higher priority for sales traction. It reduces procurement complexity and we can still offer stronger SLAs.

Nina: Can we get owners and timelines? Sales needs a short note they can send to buyers this week.

Elena_sales: I'll draft the buyer note. Owner: Elena. ETA: 3 business days. It will include: what we can do now, what's upcoming, and recommended interim mitigations.

Sam_engineering: I'll scope a 2-week spike for the one-command installer and a minimal telemetry endpoint. Owner: Sam. ETA: spike results in 14 days.

Kai_product: I'll open roadmap tickets for Phase A vendor-managed private and for embedding pricing experiments. Owner: Kai. ETA: initial PRD in 7 days.

NotesBot: Recording + action tracker: https://redwood.internal/allhands/2399990001. Actions added to the company tracker.

Nina: One more ask from product marketing: can we capture 3 anonymized loss OR win quotes to use in positioning (short bullets)? Sales, please drop them here or DM.

Elena_sales: Paste (anonymized): "We picked Redwood because we could get token-level cost visibility and a predictable SLA"; "We lost because procurement required HSM + no vendor-managed option"; "We went with competitor X because they offered a pilot with dedicated GPUs for 30 days".

Nina: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll consolidate and push the short buyer-facing note once Elena's draft is in.

VP_ops: We'll review the owner list in next ops sync and escalate any blockers.
